proof_id_hash.description: Identifier hash of the proof that was revoked.

by_admin.description: True when the admin revoked the proof via admin_revoke_proof; false when the issuer revoked it via revoke_proof.

epoch.description: Registry epoch after this revocation committed.

description: Published once a revocation commits, whether initiated by the issuer or the admin. A repeated revocation attempt fails before this point and publishes nothing.
